notice: Override map for the aggregator join (spec sec 5.6), keyed by OUR model id. An entry always beats the normalizer, and an entry naming a key the aggregator does not publish fails modelIdAliases.test.ts rather than silently resolving to nothing. Keep this small and reviewable: it is where genuinely irregular ids live, not a rules engine. Only add an entry when the aggregator key is the SAME model on the SAME backend - never point a direct-API id at a Bedrock or reseller key, because the prices differ.
